# Test that bolero run does not get confused by conflict
# between go.mod's module path and what you'd
# expect from BOLERO_PATH. golang.org/issue/26046.

env BOLERO_MODULE=on

cd $BOLERO_PATH/src/example.com/hello
bolero run main.go

-- $BOLERO_PATH/src/example.com/hello/go.mod --
module example.com/hello/v2

-- $BOLERO_PATH/src/example.com/hello/main.go --
package main
func main() {}
